description: Utility functions for user role assignment, customer/supplier creation, and contact management in ERPNext portal module.

methods.name: set_default_role
methods.description: Assigns roles to a document based on email contact links and existing role assignments.

methods.name: create_customer_or_supplier
methods.description: Creates a Customer or Supplier document based on user session and default portal settings.

methods.name: create_party_contact
methods.description: Creates a Contact linked to a Customer or Supplier party.

methods.name: party_exists
methods.description: Checks if a contact exists and is linked to a specific doctype for a given user.
